title: Immunization Services Season Calendar for Store Operations
content:
Three Immunization Services vaccinations are given by season; the other four are given year-round. For a seasonal vaccination the season opens on the first day shown and closes on the last day shown in the following calendar year. Dates are written month-day (MM-DD).

| Vaccination | Given by season | First day of the season | Last day of the season (following year) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination | Yes | 08-01 | 06-30 |
| Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination | Yes | 08-01 | 06-30 |
| COVID-19 Updated Vaccination | Yes | 09-01 | 08-31 |
| RSV Older Adult Vaccination | No | not seasonal | not seasonal |
| Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination | No | not seasonal | not seasonal |
| Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series | No | not seasonal | not seasonal |
| Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series | No | not seasonal | not seasonal |

## Worked reading of the calendar (hypothetical seasons)

- The influenza season that opens on 1 August of a hypothetical year Y runs to 30 June of year Y plus one. A date of 30 June of the following year is still inside that season; 1 July falls between seasons, and the next season opens on 1 August.
- The COVID-19 Updated Vaccination season that opens on 1 September of a hypothetical year Y runs to 31 August of year Y plus one, so the next season begins the following day.
- A season is labelled by its two years, in the form YYYY-YYYY; the non-seasonal vaccinations carry no season label.
